detail_text: Synopsis – SPRDL1-26-R-0024 ***************************************************************************************** The Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support (Warren) anticipates issuing a solicitation that will result in a 5-year, Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity Firm-Fixed Price contract for the following item: Item: Power Distribution Console NSN: 6150-01-707-0086 PPN: 888-1046 Quantity: Minimum guaranteed qty. 6 each, maximum 5-year qty. 206 each Option: N/A FOB: Destination The subject solicitation is Sole Source. No additional technical data is available. The solicitation should be released to the web on or about 08 May 2026. See the solicitation for actual closing date. Once available, the solicitation can be downloaded from SAM.gov (https://www.SAM.gov). If you have any questions, please contact the Contract Specialist, Kimberly Houghton, at (586) 230-8521 or by email at kimberly.houghton@dla.mil.
